en: The black-and-white image shows a formal entrance to a large building complex, possibly institutional or governmental, with a gated stone entrance, two tall flagpoles, and groups of uniformed people (likely soldiers or cadets) entering or gathered inside the grounds. The architecture is early 20th-century European with steep roofs, dormer windows, and a clock tower. The grounds are lined with trees and well-maintained paths, and there are several other buildings visible in the background.
